verdict.rationale: Docs show a full CLI (`foreloop init`, JSON output stable and additive) covering projects, loops, intentions, stories and tasks, plus an MCP endpoint for agent access, indicating broad parity between CLI/API and UI operations (foreloop-docs-16, foreloop-docs-9, foreloop-docs-19). However, human approval of 'big calls' is explicitly framed as a UI/mobile-only gate (foreloop-docs-20, foreloop-docs-22), suggesting at least one core workflow step is not exposed via API. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that approval/contract actions and all dashboard views (e.g., agent activity list) are also API-accessible, and independent confirmation of full UI/API feature parity.
